step_environment: step the JAX environment with an action and PRNG key to get observation, state, reward, and done flag
reset_environment: reset the JAX environment using a PRNG key to get initial observation and state
create_env_state: create an EnvState dataclass with a time integer to track environment step count
create_env_params: create an EnvParams dataclass with max_episode_steps to configure environment episode limits
get_observation_from_state: get the observation from an EnvState by calling the get_obs method on the environment
